data.title: Crowe closes strategic investment from KKR
data.description: In a recent announcement made on August 7, 2026, in Chicago and New York, Crowe LLP (Crowe), a prominent public accounting and consulting firm, disclosed its plans to persist in advancing its business strategy. The firm aims to expand its reach and enhance its capabilities. This development comes following the partnership agreement between Crowe and KKR, a top global investment firm. Funds managed by KKR will be instrumental in supporting Crowe's growth initiatives.

data.title: Havertys Furniture Third Quarter 2026 Cash Dividend and Additional Authorization Under Stock Repurchase Program
data.description: Atlanta, August 7th, 2026 - Haverty Furniture Companies, Inc. data.title: Dover Increases Dividend

data.title: CASEKOO Celebrates 10th Anniversary, Unveiling the Journey from Protection to Liberation
data.description: On August 8th, 2026, CASEKOO, a popular lifestyle accessories brand specializing in phone cases, will commemorate its 10th anniversary in Los Angeles. The brand has become well-known for its innovative phone case designs that go beyond traditional expectations. This anniversary signifies a significant shift in the capabilities of their phone cases after a decade in the industry.

data.title: U.S. Postal Service Reports Third Quarter Fiscal Year 2026 Results
data.description: With a 6.1 percent increase, the operating revenue for the current quarter stands at $19.9 billion. There was a significant improvement in financials as controllable loss decreased by $584 million and net loss by $562 million when compared to the same quarter last year. However, despite these positive third-quarter results, indicating progress, the long-term liquidity crisis still persists.

data.title: The Year of One Million Thanks Tour Heads to Wisconsin, Iowa and Minnesota State Fairs
data.description: Residents in the Midwest are encouraged to join a nationwide initiative honoring the farmers who sustain the world. data.title: In HelloNation, Insurance Expert Oscar Salas Details How Licensed Insurance Offices Handle Vehicle Registration Services
data.description: Certain insurance offices in California are now able to handle vehicle registration tasks, presenting drivers with a convenient option to traditional DMV visits. data.title: University of Phoenix research chair presents pilot findings on AI-assisted empathy at 2026 American Psychological Association convention
data.description: Dr. Rodney Luster presented initial results and ethical concerns regarding the integration of generative AI in psychotherapy and counselor education. The discussion took place in Phoenix on August 7, 2026. Dr. Luster, a University research chair and head of the Center for Leadership and Entrepreneurial Innovation, highlighted the potential benefits and challenges of incorporating AI in these fields. This development could involve pioneering research initiatives and training programs.

data.title: David Cummins confirmed as new TSA Administrator
data.description: Today, David Cummins assumed office as the eighth Administrator of the Transportation Security Administration (TSA) after being confirmed by the U.S. Senate. He aims to guide the agency towards achieving a "Golden Age of Travel." This development took place on August 7, 2026.

data.title: BANCFIRST AWARDED $400,000 TO SUPPORT AFFORDABLE HOUSING EFFORTS FOR NATIVE AMERICANS IN OKEMAH
data.description: In August 7, 2026, Oklahoma City, the Muscogee Creek Nation was among the 16 organizations chosen in 2025 to be granted funds for affordable housing initiatives by BancFirst, a member of FHLBank Topeka. The grant funds were provided as a part of FHLBank Topeka's Native American Housing program, which aims to support efforts in providing affordable housing.

data.title: Stop Letting Rogue Server Hosts Steal Your Client Data: Morpheus and Secret Network Unveil Unhackable, Zero-Snoop AI Infrastructure
data.description: On August 7, 2026, in Los Angeles, Morpheus, a decentralized marketplace specializing in AI inference, revealed a significant development. The company has formed a partnership with Secret Network to facilitate the confidential and secure operation of AI models through the utilization of Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs). This collaboration will introduce a novel TEE Provider, enhancing the privacy and security of AI model execution.

data.title: US Treasury OFAC sanctions $5 million in digital assets linked to Iran through 2 crypto exchanges for money laundering.
data.description: An individual and two cryptocurrency exchanges have been sanctioned by the US government for allegedly aiding money laundering activities involving Iran. The combined total of $5 million in digital assets has been linked to this illicit scheme.
